BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single -
Unit (Detached House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 5-L
in the area bounded by


       A line 240.00 feet north of and Parallel to West Dickens Avenue; the Alley
next east of and parallel to North LaPorte Avenue; a line 210.00 feet north of and
Parallel to West Dickens Avenue; and North LaPorte Avenue.


to those of a RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District.
